brief.prompt:
Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, wide landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger. Use case: illustration-story. It must be a raster PNG.

Art direction: match the approved black and lime basketball thumbnail visible in this conversation only in its graphic language: near-black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, ivory Japanese typography, hand-drawn ink hatching, dynamic painterly editorial illustration, clear readable face, few elements. Do not transfer any text, date, player, score or statistics from that style sample.

Subject: one REAL professional basketball player, Noboru Hasegawa (長谷川暢), Ibaraki Robots. He is randomly selected as an illustrative subject, NOT the subject of a performance claim. Official appearance reference inspected: https://www.ibarakirobots.win/team/players/detail/id=20792?PlayerID=15829 and official portrait https://ibarakirobots.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1790071776/files/user/images/player/2026-27/player3.jpg . Refer to the visible official portrait for identity only, never paste the photograph. Keep recognizable features: black medium-short hair parted near the middle, two rounded swept curtains exposing his forehead, tapered sides, oval face with slightly squared jaw, straight dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes, straight medium nose and thin closed lips; nearly clean-shaven with only faint chin stubble. Compact athletic guard build. Do not invent a different player. Render his face and body as clear hand-drawn ink illustration, never photorealistic.

Composition: player occupies the RIGHT 45%, three-quarter front view, driving forward in a low athletic stance, chest leaning into motion, focused expression, one arm bent to guide an orange basketball low near his hip while the other arm naturally protects space. Ball is a prop handled by this player. Keep face, both hands and complete ball comfortably inside frame, anatomically coherent arms and five fingers on each visible hand, no duplicated limbs. Plain dark/ivory basketball uniform with minimal blue and orange trim, NO numbers, names, team crests, sponsor text, league symbols or sportswear logos. Do not reproduce any jersey graphics from the reference. Dry-brush diagonal lime motion marks behind the player; no opponent, crowd, scoreboard, hoop or extra small illustrations. This is a generic imagined basketball movement, not a depiction of any actual game moment.

Text hierarchy: Left 55% provides generous uncluttered text area with strong margin, text never touches player.
Top left modest brand text, exactly: "バスケまとめ"
Under brand large lime date, exactly: "11/13"
Main dominant headline beneath date in very heavy ivory Japanese sans serif, exactly: "試合予定"
Under headline one readable line, exactly: "B.PREMIER / B.ONE"
Lower left a compact readable qualifier block, exact two lines:
"全試合の公式記録確定待ち"
"2026.11.13 02:30 JST時点"
At bottom left with safe margin, exact readable note: "イラスト（AI生成）"
At bottom right with safe margin, exact note: "イメージ"
Do not add any other text. Ensure all Japanese glyphs, punctuation, numerals and Latin letters are perfectly legible and accurate. Footer text should be smaller than headline but visibly readable.

Content basis: fixed source article only says games are scheduled and all official game records are awaiting confirmation at 2026-11-13 02:30 JST. No confirmed player appearances, statistics, rankings, MVP, best-five, score, win/loss or successful scoring action may be claimed. Do not put the selected player's name anywhere in image. No official photographs, no logos, no watermarks beyond the specified AI disclosure. Deliver a polished, bold, visually striking thumbnail with one distinct illustration and simple typographic hierarchy.
